LanguageData.DMS_Make_BullHound.label: Gestate bullhound
LanguageData.DMS_Make_BullHound.description: Gestate a bullhound automatroid, a heavy quadruped garrison mech. An enlarged derivative of the Dogge, it trades the artificial-muscle agility of its smaller cousin for thick plating and a fixed back mount, and was built to hold gates and corridor junctions against intruders at close range.\n\nThis pattern mounts an automatic shotgun. The mount is fixed and cannot be swapped, the bullhound is slow on open ground, and it demands three points of bandwidth.
LanguageData.DMS_Make_BullHound_Flamer.label: Gestate hellhound
LanguageData.DMS_Make_BullHound_Flamer.description: Gestate a hellhound automatroid, the flamer pattern of the bullhound: a heavy quadruped garrison mech. An enlarged derivative of the Dogge, it trades the artificial-muscle agility of its smaller cousin for thick plating and a fixed back mount, and was built to hold gates and corridor junctions against intruders at close range.\n\nThis pattern mounts a Flameblaster for clearing corridors, with its plating treated against its own flame. The mount is fixed and cannot be swapped, the hellhound is slow on open ground, and it demands three points of bandwidth.
